_: M3.2, M3.4B, M3.5, M3.6B and M3.10B: the commit that applied each recovery stream. tools/build-data-gap-register.py records it on the gaps the stream resolved; the register keeps every gap, with its original id and counts.

M3.2A.what: figures gain their own held sheet as source (APPLY_PROVENANCE rows of data/audit/m32-recovery-candidates.jsonl)
M3.2A.note: 4 of the 716 applied here were withdrawn by the stricter blend rule in a556a01 (a second blend on the sheet); 712 stand

M3.2B.what: figures whose own held sheet had no address gain the first-party address that served exactly those bytes (APPLY_PLACEMENT rows)

M3.2C.what: figures stated in held PDF sheets whose text was never stored, read as the sheet reader reads them (APPLY_PROVENANCE rows, stream C)

M3.2D.what: vintage figures the model lacked, stated in exactly mapped harvested sheets (APPLY_VALUE rows)

M3.4B.what: document-less vintages linked to an audited accepted document (APPLIED rows of data/audit/m3.4b-mapping-application.jsonl); only "no document" is resolved, the vintage's figures stay with their own gaps

M3.5.what: document-less vintages a reviewed held document now documents, by its own title (eligible rows of data/audit/m3.5-held-document-review.jsonl); only "no document" is resolved, the vintage's figures stay with their own gaps

M3.6B.what: document-less vintages an audited fetched web page now documents, by its own main heading (APPLIED rows of data/audit/m3.6b-mapping-application.jsonl); only "no document" is resolved, the vintage's figures stay with their own gaps

M3.10B.what: document-less vintages an accepted, externally acquired document now documents (APPLIED decision rows of data/audit/m3.10b-evidence-decisions.jsonl, evidence version 9); only "no document" is resolved, the vintage's figures stay with their own gaps
